title: Conventional unit identity
responsibility: Derives a unit kind and name from a workspace-relative conventional source path.

inputs.name: unitIdentity.path
inputs.description: Forward-slash path relative to its workspace, using supported src, scripts, db or crates conventions.

outputs.name: unitIdentity
outputs.description: Kind, kebab-case name and dotted id, or undefined for unrecognized/empty identities. Rust crate files share one kernel id; route files and conventional folder suffixes follow their specific naming rules.
